content_direction.premise: Each story addresses a documented substantial migrant difficulty in Germany: learning German, understanding official letters, discrimination or navigating Jobcenter and immigration offices. Original comic reenactments must identify their factual basis and invented details.
content_direction.teaching: One useful German phrase or distinction per episode, taught through visible objects and actions.
content_direction.continuity: Nine natural-speed five-second shots: immediate visible problem, two connected comic escalations, practical action and a visible comic payoff. Never mock nationality, accent or vulnerability.
content_direction.graphics: Clearly labelled illustrative appointment app beside the speaker. A real named app needs verified UI. No real booking, patient data, face cloning or voice cloning.
content_direction.credit_policy: Daily production is authorized only within verified included allowance; no paid or anonymous fallback and at most one start per Berlin day.
content_direction.daily_improvement: Use research/series-improvement-rules.json and real available analytics. Record one small experiment and one previous weakness addressed; do not promise more views or invent measurements.
